audio_description:
The camera sweeps through the ball's grand hall, arched windows framing a huge moon.
On the crowded floor, Rinoa, in a cream dress, approaches Squall in his dress uniform.
They pair off and waltz together among the other couples.

context.scene_title: 'Waltz for the Moon' — the SeeD graduation/inauguration ball on Disc 1, where Squall and Rinoa first meet and dance. One of the game's most iconic romantic scenes.
locations: The Balamb Garden ballroom/grand hall, with tall arched windows opening onto a starlit night sky and a large moon

characters.name: Rinoa Heartilly
characters.recognition: Young woman with long straight black hair (with caramel-brown highlights) wearing a pale cream/ivory halter cocktail dress with a crossed neckline; warm, confident smile. The female lead.

characters.name: Squall Leonhart
characters.recognition: Seen here in his dark SeeD dress uniform with gold trim; the brooding male protagonist. He is the partner she pulls onto the dance floor.

characters.name: Other SeeD cadets/guests
characters.recognition: Background couples in formal dress dancing in the ballroom.

context.summary: At the SeeD graduation ball, the camera sweeps past the grand hall's arched windows framing a huge moon. On the crowded dance floor, Rinoa, radiant in a cream halter dress, approaches and pairs off with Squall in his dress uniform amid other dancing couples. The clip captures their celebrated first encounter and waltz under the moonlight.
